limits: Sum of per-process Windows working sets can double-count shared pages; it is not private RAM or total system memory.
CDP SystemInfo.getProcessInfo identifies only this fresh browser instance; helper Node/PowerShell and other applications are excluded.
Each process is read sequentially, not in an atomic OS snapshot. Processes may exit between CDP enumeration and Get-Process; missing reads are recorded and invalidate the sample.
Point-in-time measurement after fixed mounting workload and wait, not peak memory, long-running convergence, leak test or operational workload.
No forced garbage collection; fresh browser each sample, existing OS/file caches and host noise remain.
Three paired samples per node count; p95 is nearest-rank maximum, not a reliable tail estimate.
JS heap from the page Performance CDP session is separate from process working set; never add them.
Before has random layout, after deterministic layout and adaptive text; all original nodes/edges remain expanded.
